title: Caramel Macchiato Banana Bread
description: This caramel macchiato banana bread is a sophisticated upgrade from regular banana bread, with a subtle coffee flavor and a decadent caramel glaze.
ingredients: 0.5 cup caramel macchiato flavored liquid coffee creamer (such as International Delight®)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray.
Whisk flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt together in a bowl.

Mash bananas in a large mixing bowl with a fork until almost smooth. Stir in coffee creamer, sugar, oil, eggs, and instant coffee granules until coffee granules have dissolved. Gradually stir in flour mixture, about 1/2 cup at a time, until batter is almost smooth. Pour batter into the prepared loaf pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean, about 1 hour. Allow to cool before removing from pan, about 30 minutes.

While the bread is cooling, melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Mix in brown sugar and vanilla and bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve sugar. Reduce the heat and simmer syrup for 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool to a warm but liquid temperature.
Pour glaze over cooled banana bread. Serve when glaze has set.

video.description: Enjoy a slice of banana bread with a kick of caffeine and tempting sweetness from coffee creamer! First mix together flour with baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Then mash some ripe bananas and combine with caramel macchiato-flavored creamer, oil, eggs, sugar and instant coffee. Combine with your dry ingredients, then pour into a loaf baking pan and bake. Make a rich glaze by simmering melted unsalted butter with brown sugar and vanilla. Pour over the cooled loaf and serve thick, tender and delicious slices when set.
